# The PFTC model {.unnumbered}

This book is the teaching material for the Plant Functional Trait Courses (PFTC).
The courses are hands-on training in trait-based ecology.
More about the courses themselves is on the course [webpage](https://plantfunctionaltraitscourses.w.uib.no/).

The courses teach data collection, curation, analysis, documentation, storage, and reuse.
They also show reproducible workflows, so the research can be checked and used again.
The topics sit in plant functional trait ecology, ecosystem ecology, plant physiology, and remote sensing.

The chapters follow the course: [pre-course](plan_logistics.qmd), the [field course](first_days.qmd), and [post-course](course_evaluation.qmd).
Under each of those, the chapters are grouped by step: Plan, Design, Collect, and the steps that follow.
The four larger groups on the wheel — Create, Process, Share, and Re-use — overlap those times, so they are not the sidebar groups.
The PFTC model sits underneath that timeline.
The inner ring is the scientific process, in four parts: Create, Process, Share, and Re-use.
Around it, from the centre outward, are the documents, the methods, and the community.

A page that belongs to one of these carries a sign in the colour from the wheels.
Some pages are not part of a category, and those have no sign.

```{=html}
<div class="model-signs" aria-label="Colours used on the PFTC model">
```
